description: You are preparing for small claims court to recover your $1,200 security deposit. Your landlord wrongfully withheld it claiming damages that existed before you moved in. Create an organized evidence log spreadsheet with: (1) columns for Date, Evidence Type, Description, Supports Claim, Dollar Amount, and Days Since Move-In; (2) all 10 evidence items from the provided text file, entered chronologically; (3) calculated days since move-in (March 1, 2024); (4) a summary section showing deposit amount, landlord's claims, your expenses, and amount owed; (5) conditional formatting highlighting pre-existing damage evidence (green), move-out walkthrough (yellow), and landlord damage claims (red). Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/deposit_evidence.xlsx
